item.title: The Pentagon's guidelines for "responsible AI" aren't always followed, report shows
item.description: The Pentagon is building weapons and projects with AI capabilities that officials say don't always closely adhere to the agency's own guidelines for AI, according to a congressional watchdog report published in October.

item.title: Ohio could decide control of the Senate. Its rural voters might decide the winner
item.description: Ohio has been a reliably red state for several elections but it's competitive this year. If Democrats want to prevail, they'll have to win people who have backed Republicans, like rural voters.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: A D.C. park was made 'for the pleasure of the people.' Trump's plan would change that
item.description: Trump's most recent rendering of East Potomac Park overtakes the D.C. peninsula with a sprawling golf course, without the grassy areas and road beloved by locals. That's prompted grassroots pushback.

item.title: Gen Z is 'in the thick' of high housing costs. These candidates aim to solve it
item.description: Young candidates who rent or live with parents say their generation is "in the thick" of the country's housing affordability crisis. They argue this gives them new energy to solve it for everyone.

item.title: Jet fuel prices hit a record and holiday airfares soar higher
item.description: If you're planning to fly this holiday season, be prepared to pay more than you did last year. The price of jet fuel — one of airlines' biggest expenses — is at an all-time high in the U.S.

item.title: Trump merchandise stores are closing: 'He has peaked'
item.description: At least four Trump merchandise stores have closed this year. Store owners say with President Trump in his final term, there isn't as much to fire up his consumer fan base and sales have softened.

item.title: How long does it take to save up for a starter home? Twice as long as it did in 2019
item.description: A new analysis finds that the average renter household now needs 16 years to save for a down payment and closing costs. Rising rents and other costs have consumed a growing share of household budgets.
